title: Consumer Version Extreme Heat Response Plan - San Diego County, United States of America
organization: County of San Diego Health and Human Services Agency (HHSA; PHS)
landscapes: Arid, Urban, Household, Institutional, Occupational, Athletics
description:
In efforts to limit the adverse health effects from
extreme heat, this Extreme Heat Response Plan (the Plan) contains definitions and
established guidelines for how the County of San Diego will respond to events of
extreme heat.
